features.name: any_comment_has_url
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain a direct URL or external link?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings. Return 1 if any comment matches regex r'(https?://|www\.)\S+' (case-insensitive), else 0. Empty list -> 0; missing or malformed JSON -> null. Raw text match, no semantic filtering.

h0: any_comment_has_url has no association with the likelihood of view change (delta).
h1: Discussions with any_comment_has_url = 1 have a higher likelihood of view change than those with 0.
note: Comparison group "solely internal text" is operationalized as no comment containing a URL/link (feature = 0). Only literal http(s):// or www. links are detected; bare domains or markdown links without scheme are missed. Comments may include quoted URLs from the OP or outcome-related text; raw text, not checked for timing or outcome contamination. Linear OLS on binary delta (linear probability model); association only.
